A coherent listing: everything the gate reads is legible, nothing tested is
below what is required, and the two minimums are the ones the plugin header and
Constants declare.

== Description ==

This listing is a fixture of the version-coherence gate and is never published.
The WordPress version it declares as tested - 7.2 - is on purpose NOT the one the
real readme.txt of this repository declares: the emission mode has to print what
the listing it was pointed at says, and a fixture that repeated the real
declaration would pass just as happily against a gate that printed a hardcoded
pair.

The WooCommerce one, in contrast, IS the real one, because that claim is also
written in the plugin header of this repository and the gate compares the two.

The minimums are the real ones for the same reason: the gate compares them
against the plugin header and Constants of this repository, and this fixture is
the case where nothing disagrees.
